result:
All thirteen CHECK.md items are resolved. Twelve were fixed in code; one (item 6) is answered in the notes with an output extension, because the literal requirement cannot be met.

**Code fixes in `code/run.R`**

- Item 1: the parquet raw-byte reader now removes only NUL bytes. Bytes above 0x7f are kept as latin1 characters. The real data contain none, so results are unchanged.
- Item 2: camp code-list codes and the crosswalk confidence, place name and coordinate text are cleaned before comparison. No supplied value was padded, so no effect on these data.
- Item 3: with `coords = "nara_degree"`, crosswalk coordinates are used only when the text is absent. Present but unparsable text now gives a missing distance. Every text in the supplied crosswalk parses.
- Item 4: `dup_serial = "combine"` combines the nine original record fields, CARD_NUM included, and then applies the card layout to the combined record.
- Item 5: an interaction product with a missing component gets its own missing indicator. Under the grid's membership rule this indicator exactly duplicates an existing one in S000, so it has no numerical effect there.
- Item 7: camp dummies are binary regressors, so their marginal effects are discrete changes with matching delta-method gradients.
- Item 8: the complete-case filter binds its group type, so captured-cohort R_cc models no longer require distance.
- Item 9: R_aaf group variables are computed over the AAF rows of R, since line 91 gives no pre-subsetting exception.
- Item 10: friends with `incl_self` counts members with the same unit only. Non-member rows are no longer counted.
- Items 11 and 12: the estimation frame is written to the sample-ID file and retained for the influence loop before fitting, so failed base fits still produce both.
- Item 13: families run in the grid's listed order, with T5ROC right after T5 and INFLUENCE last.

**Item 6, explained rather than changed.** Line 52 requires one indicator per variable with missing values, but in S000 the indicators for hierarchy, men and men_sq are identical columns. A maximum-likelihood probit with exactly collinear columns has no unique solution, so at least one must go. The code omits only numerically exact dependence and keeps the hierarchy's indicator. What changed: every omitted column now appears in results.csv as a term row with NA estimates and is named in the error column. In S000 T4 only `men_miss` and `men_sq_miss` are affected, and no camp dummy is merged.

**Tests and real-data runs.** Tests were updated and extended (new tests 8 to 12 and pipeline checks 7t to 7y, including a deliberately failed base fit). All 75 checks pass; the log is at `code/tests/test_log.txt`. On the real data I ran variable construction for S000, S018, S019 and S020, and the S000 T4 family with influence off. All eight fits converge with the same N, clusters and dropped camps as before. Outputs are in `code/results/`.

**Notes.** `code/NOTES.md` has a new section 8, "Check round 1 responses", with one entry per item citing the manifest lines, and the earlier sections that the fixes made stale were corrected.

One judgment call worth flagging: items 5 and 9 rest on the checker's reading of ambiguous manifest text, and I adopted that reading in both cases. The notes record the reasoning so it can be reversed if the manifest authors intended otherwise.
